property.name: Dragon Treasure Transient & Condotel
property.location: 95-B Vergara 2 Alley, Engineers' Hill, Baguio City, Philippines, 2600
property.description: Dragon Treasure Transient & Condotel offers premium, modern minimalist accommodations with cozy Baguio feels, white walls, dark wood accents, matte black industrial fixtures, and red accents. Features short-term transient rooms and peaceful student dormitory bedspaces.

bookingProcess: Guests select a room, choose check-in/check-out dates, enter their name and contact information, and submit a reservation request. The booking is confirmed after approval.

cancellationPolicy.upTo24Hours: Up to 24 hours before check-in: no cancellation fee
cancellationPolicy.lessThan24Hours: Less than 24 hours before check-in: may be subject to a cancellation fee

dormitoryUtilityBilling.waterBilling: Calculated automatically from submeter consumption at ₱45.00 per cubic meter (m³)
dormitoryUtilityBilling.electricityBilling: Calculated automatically from submeter consumption at ₱14.50 per kilowatt-hour (kWh)
dormitoryUtilityBilling.howDormersViewBills: Dormers can view their automated monthly utility bill and itemized breakdown by logging into their account on the Dragon Treasure website, clicking their profile icon in the navigation bar, and opening 'Client Dashboard'.
dormitoryUtilityBilling.howDormersPayBills: Dormers can settle their bills directly online via GCash, Maya, or Bank Transfer by clicking 'Pay Online' inside their Invoices dashboard and submitting the transaction reference number.
